## Type of change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧹 Chore / refactor / tooling (no runtime changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] Linked an issue (or explained why none exists)
- [ ] Docs updated (README / CHANGELOG / code comments as needed)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, passwords, or private URLs in the diff
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks passed locally
- [ ] CI is green
